bio.text: Zyon Khalifa is the Democratic nominee for South Carolina's 2nd Congressional District, held by Republican Rep. Joe Wilson, after winning the June 23, 2026 runoff with 53.8 percent of the vote.
The Post and Courier described Khalifa as a political newcomer, a former University of South Carolina athlete and attorney, and an Air Force veteran who graduated from USC in 2023.

sources.title: SC Democrats decide who will challenge Joe Wilson for seat in Congress
